description: Name Manager dialog that lists all named ranges in the workbook, allows filtering, and raises events for New / Edit / Delete. The list is a WAI-ARIA grid with a roving tabindex: the selected row is the single tab stop and carries the DOM focus, Up/Down/Home/End move the selection, Enter edits the selected range, Delete deletes it (the neighbour takes the selection) and a double click edits. The dialog itself is a modal overlay whose role, aria-modal, accessible name, initial focus, Escape handling and focus restore come from the core TmFocusScope; all element ids are per instance and none is a selector contract.

parameters.name: Workbook
parameters.description: The workbook whose named ranges are being managed.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised when the user wants to delete the selected named range.

parameters.name: OnEdit
parameters.description: Raised when the user wants to edit the selected named range.

parameters.name: OnNew
parameters.description: Raised when the user wants to create a new named range.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to on close — the host spreadsheet passes its grid root so focus lands on the grid. Null falls back to the element focused before the dialog opened.
